actions.label: Tri-Cam: allow arming without cameras
actions.description: Overrides the Tri-Cam readiness block for the NEXT arming only (no node, camera or usable SD card on a channel). Deliberate: the flight will not have all its images. Audited.

actions.label: Tri-Cam: cancel the arming override
actions.description: Cancels a pending Tri-Cam arming override.
